name: Octelium Open-Source Zero Trust Access
free_limit: Free, self-hosted zero-trust access platform for VPN-like WireGuard/QUIC connectivity, identity-aware application gateways and policy-controlled private-resource access; open-source core has no vendor license fee or hosted-usage quota.
watch_out: Requires self-operated Kubernetes, compute, networking, DNS and storage, which can incur charges. Cluster/server components are AGPL-3.0, clients Apache-2.0; comply with AGPL network-use/source obligations. Enterprise-only features and alternative commercial licensing are separate paid offerings; no vendor-hosted free infrastructure is included.
